items.title: Move the execution plan into a dedicated Lattice story worktree
items.context: Apply the already drafted decision-doc promotion execution plan and NAV update inside the story worktree so review and DONE gates operate on the actual changed files.
items.userSees: The document changes are tracked by a dedicated Lattice story rather than an ad hoc main edit.

happy.desc: The drafted execution plan and NAV entry exist in the B-16eb story worktree and are tracked as story-scoped changes.

edge.desc: Only the allowed document files and Lattice story metadata are changed; no implementation files are pulled into this doc-audit story.

adversarial.desc: The plan changes are not accepted as an ad hoc main edit or unstaged historical patch; they must pass this story worktree lifecycle.

items.title: Audit the plan for scope, freshness, and Authority boundaries
items.context: Ensure the plan forbids DEV-time scope expansion, requires proposal/source-decision freshness, and keeps local quorum separate from Authority/production completion.
items.userSees: The execution plan explicitly protects scope and Authority boundaries.

happy.desc: The execution plan explicitly covers DEV-time scope boundaries, proposal/source decision digest freshness, and local Authority boundary language.

edge.desc: NAV and path references remain consistent with docs/requirements/decisions/decision-doc-promotion-execution-plan.md.

adversarial.desc: The document does not sneak in implementation of decision_doc_proposal, decision_doc_save, configurable paths, Authority semantics, or productionDone semantics.

items.title: Run 3 round 2 host review evidence for the decision doc
items.context: Because the story changes docs/requirements/decisions/*.md, record local host_verdict evidence for three distinct rounds and two distinct hosts per round, then verify the decision_doc_quorum_check diagnostic.
items.userSees: The decision-doc quorum diagnostic reports pass for this story.

happy.desc: decision_doc_quorum_check reports pass for B-16eb after three rounds with two distinct hosts per round record fresh host_verdict evidence for the current decision-doc digest.

edge.desc: The diagnostic rejects stale, duplicate-host, prose-only, or insufficient-round evidence instead of silently passing the doc change.

adversarial.desc: DONE cannot rely on the author narrative alone; it must consume structured fresh host_verdict evidence for this decision document.
